newsitem.title: USA: Community First Bankshares sets redemption.
newsitem.headline: Community First Bankshares sets redemption.

text.p: Community First Bankshares Inc, a multi-bank holding company, said Friday it will redeem on March 31 all 899,050 depositary shares, each representing one-quarter of a share of the company's seven percent cumulative preferred stock.
The redemption price is $26.40 per depositary share, plus $0.4375 in accrued and unpaid dividends.

It said shareholders have the right to convert the shares prior to redemption into Community First common at a rate of 1.569 shares of common per depositary share. The rate corresponds to a conversion price of $15.934 per share of common stock issuable on conversion.

Separately, Community First also said it will redeem on March 31 all of its 7.75 percent subordinated notes due April 15, 2000. The redemption price is 100 percent of the principal amount, plus interest.
The subordinated notes were issued in April 1993. The principal amount outstanding is $23 million.
